text.hero-copy: Product videos that make your benefits clear and your brand memorable. FØMØ Studio helps brands and creative agencies turn ideas into finished video for advertising, social media and product launches.
text.copy-1: See what we can bring to your brand.
text.section-intro: Explore product stories, visual concepts and examples of our production craft.
text.disclosure: Independent portfolio concepts. These brand examples are self-initiated, not commissioned by or affiliated with the featured brands.
text.copy-2: Turn your product’s strongest selling point into a compelling story.
text.services-copy: What makes your product worth choosing? We build the creative around that answer—with purposeful visuals, clear messaging and a finish that reflects your brand. From a striking product reveal to a short ad demonstrating a key benefit, every project starts with what you want your audience to understand and do.
text.copy-4: Introduce your product with distinctive visuals that bring its features, benefits and personality to life.
text.copy-6: Short videos with focused messaging, alternative openings and formats your marketing team can launch and test.
text.copy-8: Bring your product into compelling settings with 3D product work, compositing and careful attention to its distinctive details.
text.copy-10: Editing, motion design, compositing and 3D product work to help your team bring a concept through to final delivery.
text.copy-11: A clear message. A collaborative process.
text.copy-13: We discuss your product, audience, placement and the action you want viewers to take.
text.copy-15: Review the concept and key visuals before full production begins.
text.copy-17: We combine AI-assisted production with professional editing, motion design and compositing, giving your product details careful attention.
text.copy-19: Receive finished assets for your campaign. When your team shares performance feedback, we can use it to guide the next creative revision.
text.copy-20: What should your next video help your business achieve?
text.offer: Start with one product and a focused idea. Our Product Video Pilot includes one short product video, two opening variations and agreed social formats—giving your team creative options to test. We agree on the scope, timeline and fixed price before production begins.
text.about: FØMØ Studio is led by Marco Avanzi, an advertising and production professional whose background includes agency work on accounts such as Coca-Cola, Mastercard and Chevrolet. Today, Marco combines that experience with AI-assisted production and professional post-production to help brands and agencies create distinctive, purposeful video.
text.contact-intro: Tell us about your product, your audience and where the video will run. We’ll recommend a focused creative approach.
